title: BetterMakati structured civic observations
purpose: Capture dated condition snapshots for civic registry entities using directly observable, reusable evidence instead of generic numeric ratings.
principles: An observation is a dated snapshot, not a rating, review, complaint, case, or canonical place fact.
Every observation references one existing canonical Civic Registry entityId. Location-only observations are out of scope.
Questions describe things a person can directly observe at a place or during a trip.
Unknown and not-observed are valid answers; the form must never force a guess.
No overall score, star rating, weighted index, grade, ranking, or good/bad entity label is stored or derived in W3R-6.
Submitting an observation never opens a civic case automatically and never changes Place Registry verification, lifecycle, access, management, or provenance.
A contributor may separately file a problem report when an observed condition warrants action.
Observation summaries must retain date/freshness and sample counts so stale or thin evidence is visible.

observedAt.description: When the contributor directly observed the conditions, not when the form was submitted.

weatherContext.description: Useful especially for drainage, shade, heat and surface observations.

value.description: Must be one of the question's enumerated choices or satisfy its numeric constraint.

note.description: Brief factual context for this answer.

entityId.description: Stable canonical Civic Registry entity ID. Must resolve at submission time.

validationRules: entityId must resolve to a Civic Registry record at submission time.
familyId must match the entity's primaryCategory through familyMapping.
questionId must exist in the selected family's question set.
If a question has appliesTo, the entity primaryCategory must be included.
Each questionId may appear at most once in one observation.
At least one answer is required.
Answers must use the declared response type; unknown conditions must use the explicit not-observed choice rather than invented values.
observedAt cannot be in the future beyond a small clock-skew allowance.
submittedAt is generated by storage and cannot be supplied as authoritative by the contributor.
No observation field may update Civic Registry canonical facts automatically.
No observation automatically creates, confirms, resolves, forwards or otherwise changes a civic case.
No overallScore, stars, averageRating, grade, rank, recommendation, or compositeIndex field is permitted.

retiredRatingModel.rule: Generic 1–5 ratings are retired and replaced by structured observations.
retiredRatingModel.replacementPattern: Where useful, a former rating criterion is decomposed into directly observable questions rather than carried forward as a numeric scale.

allowed: most recent observed value per question
counts by answer choice within a stated time window
freshness label based on explicit age thresholds
distribution of numeric wait-time observations with sample count and time window
forbidden: conversion of categorical answers to hidden numeric scores
aggregationContract.minimumDisplayRule: Any summary must show observation count and recency/time window alongside the condition result.

implementation.notObservedPolicy: Exclude not-observed answers from substantive per-question summaries while retaining the total observation count.
implementation.numericWaitSummary: Show latest value plus 90-day median and range with sample count.
implementation.renderingClock: Use API asOf timestamp so freshness and window boundaries are deterministic within a response.

privacyAndSafety: Do not collect precise contributor home/work location; observations attach only to the selected canonical civic entity.
Do not collect sensitive demographic attributes.
Free-text notes must warn against names, faces, medical details, allegations about identifiable people, or other sensitive personal information.
Emergency conditions remain reports routed to 911, not observation answers.
Potentially actionable defects may be offered a separate Report a problem action in W3R-6b, but an observation itself does not create that case.

implementationBoundary.W3R6a: Schema only. No UI, API, storage, migration, derived summary, or rating deletion.
implementationBoundary.W3R6b: Implement one reusable observation form/storage path using this schema. Retire generic rating entry points; do not derive scores.
implementationBoundary.W3R6c: Show recent condition/freshness summaries only under the aggregation contract.

validation.reusableForm: Every civic-registry detail page can expose one structured observation form selected from the entity's observation family.
validation.storage: Observations use the dedicated /api/civic-observation endpoint and [Civic Observations] per-entity GitHub threads with civic-observation metadata comments.
validation.rawRetrieval: GET /api/civic-observation?entityId=<id> returns raw observations for later summaries; it derives no scores.
validation.canonicalValidation: The server resolves submitted entityId against the 88-record canonical civic-entity index and overwrites client-supplied entity name/category before family/question validation.
validation.schemaEnforcement: Server validates family/category, question-set version, question IDs, question applicability, answer types/choices, observed time, time context and weather context.
validation.ratingRetirement: The generic numeric rating write path and rating criteria were removed.
validation.ratingCleanup: Obsolete rating compatibility and rating outputs were removed.
validation.lifecycleSeparation: Observation storage contains no civic-admin lifecycle, referral eligibility, duplicate-case behavior or case-state promotion.
validation.noDerivedScores: No overall score, stars, average rating, weighted score, grade, rank or composite index is generated or stored.
validation.integrityGate: check:observations validates 16 categories mapped exactly once, 88 canonical place IDs, 5 families, 41 questions, dedicated storage, rating-write retirement and lifecycle separation; it is wired into quality and build.
validation.ci: Latest completed CI after the implementation reports only the same three pre-existing unused-import ESLint errors and existing warnings. No new errors are reported for the observation form, observation definitions, observation API, CivicAsset, CivicContributionForm or civicMap; downstream checks/build remain skipped behind the baseline lint failure.

validation.display: Every civic-registry detail page shows recent structured condition summaries above the observation form.

freshness.reference: API-supplied asOf timestamp for deterministic rendering

validation.notObservedHandling: Values beginning with not-observed are excluded from condition-value summaries and 90-day substantive sample counts.
validation.noCompositeScores: No overall score, average rating, weighted composite, grade, ranking, best/worst label or hidden numeric conversion is produced.
validation.refresh: A newly saved observation increments observationRevision and refreshes the summary immediately.
validation.ci: After fixing one render-purity error and one effect warning introduced in the first pass, the completed CI run reports only the same three pre-existing unused-import errors and six existing warnings. No new lint errors remain in CivicObservationSummary.tsx or related W3R-6c files.

entityTreatment.place: Destination-like physical sites use place-oriented questions such as entrance access, seating, toilets and service information.
entityTreatment.segment: Bounded infrastructure segments use segment-oriented questions such as continuity, surface, crossing access, drainage, lighting and obstruction.
entityTreatment.route: Transport routes use trip/service questions such as service operation, wait time, route/fare information, boarding and crowding.
